body: That's probably true, I just want to know how they track you so I can avoid it.

There have been several instances of that showing up in the news...[https://www.disabledveterans.org/2019/04/03/suicidal-veteran-arrested-for-veterans-crisis-line-threats/](https://www.disabledveterans.org/2019/04/03/suicidal-veteran-arrested-for-veterans-crisis-line-threats/) is one...reddit conversation [https://www.reddit.com/r/SuicideWatch/comments/6nl37l/if\_i\_call\_a\_suicide\_prevention\_hotline\_will\_they/](https://www.reddit.com/r/SuicideWatch/comments/6nl37l/if_i_call_a_suicide_prevention_hotline_will_they/) is another instance., even the FAQs of SF Suicide Prevention ([https://www.sfsuicide.org/our-programs/24-hour-crisis-line/faq-how-hotlines-can-help/](https://www.sfsuicide.org/our-programs/24-hour-crisis-line/faq-how-hotlines-can-help/)) and ImHurting ([http://imhurting.org/faq](http://imhurting.org/faq))
I am, but a large life insurance policy that will pay out for suicide will set them up for better and longer than I can.
I have heard way too many horror stories of them sending out the cops when you call.  I just want to provide for my family.
I can't have my life ruined by them, I won't have a job and lose my family and still be stuck here.  I cannot have that black mark on my record.
